constraints.sourceName: Vegagerðin (Icelandic Road and Coastal Administration) — highland road opening dates
constraints.travellerNote: The highland roads in are unsurfaced F-roads with river fords, open only in high summer and only to a high-clearance four-wheel drive; a hire car's insurance usually excludes them.
constraints.alternative: A highland day-tour bus from the south coast reaches the same place without driving an F-road.

constraints.travellerNote: The island is reached by the Landeyjahöfn ferry, and a car space has to be booked ahead in summer.
